hotels.title: China Adults-Only Tranquil Escape w. Two 18-Hole Championship Golf Courses & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Set beside two championship golf courses consistently ranked among the top golf courses in Asia, as well as a tranquil lake and mountain range, this refined resort offers a polished base in Kunming’s Spring City. The setting brings together manicured fairways, cool mountain air and wide-open water views as you take on either the Lakeview Course, designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., or the Mountainview Course designed by Jack Nicklaus. Dine on Yunnan specialities at the resort’s restaurants, then head to nearby Yangzong Lake for boating or lakeside walks. Kunming’s Stone Forest, with its dramatic limestone formations, lies within day-trip distance, while local tea houses and markets add further regional flavours. At the resort, Heng SPA soothes the body and soul after a day on the green.
